entries.averment: The second motion is moved within eighteen months of the first-motion order.
The second motion is moved after the six-month cooling-off period, or a waiver application is attached.

source.ref: s.13B(2) HMA; Amardeep Singh v. Harveen Kaur

entries.averment: Where a waiver of the cooling-off period is sought, the settlement has already been implemented.
